proposed_capability: Rebase the existing opt-in inert semantic VAE candidate review program against current main; add portable, manually reviewed semantic judgment-case bundle export and repository-intake audit, with strict allowlisted fields, digest/replay safeguards, explicit separate consent and no automatic collection/upload/model promotion or game effects.
player_save_control_impact: Local training stays profile and context scoped, opt-in and private by default. Separate explicit consent is required to export model weights; weights can still leak training information. Export excludes raw samples, replay IDs, world/save hashes and names. Untrusted candidates are JSON-only data, never imported to live native gameplay or authorized as a controller. Developers and maintainers must manually review security, licensing and genuinely independent multi-host holdout evidence.
expected_outcome: Mainline-compatible community learning candidate validation plus consent-gated semantic training-case bundles for manually submitted contributor PRs. The bridge reuses existing judgment-learning validation, strips raw observation references, rejects malformed private fields, audits submitted bundles, and keeps cross-host generalization, security clearance, gameplay runtime, developer permissions and releases human-reviewed and unproven.
negative_tests: Local training consent does not imply export or network consent
No permission or undertrained model yields no contribution artifact
Reject duplicate JSON keys, unknown fields, nonfinite/non-numeric tensors, invalid shapes, oversized payloads and changed tensor digests
Never serialize context_hash, samples, seen_bloom, save IDs or profile IDs
Synthetic/self-reported metrics are not promotion proof
Two identical test cohorts are not independent
Underperforming or adversarial candidate never passes research benchmark
No model candidate grants game/OS action authority
No automatic developer approval, code merge, telemetry, download or update
Reject leaked observation_ref, paths, Sim names or extra fields in exported community case bundle
Reject case and bundle digest tampering, duplicate semantic examples and inconsistent patch/platform
No local training records automatically committed or uploaded; static CI audit proves schema, not independent gameplay generalization
rollback_path: Revert isolated scripts/tests/docs/contracts PR; no model storage changes, no user profile migration, no live hook, network sharing or save/game modifications. Retain existing local model and BI-002 gate.
unresolved_unknowns: No independently attested cross-host Sims 4 trained candidate or trusted heldout dataset available through GitHub provider
No live Windows game host, package implementation or verified gameplay effect
Reviewers must establish real provenance, privacy leakage resistance, malicious model behavior screening and multi-host efficacy before acceptance
Developer candidacy and repository write privileges remain human-controlled
Existing draft PR #226 is diverged and merge-conflicted; new branch will preserve its source while keeping the draft intact.
GitHub provider cannot certify Windows Sims gameplay or local MoonWake prompt_group_walk runtime.
decision_rationale: P141 considered: automatic federated uploads (reject: privacy and poisoning); only VAE weight export (insufficient to share reusable training cases, leakage risk); raw gameplay data pull requests (reject: personal saves and screenshot exposure); existing PR #226 plus reviewed semantic-case intake (select: portable, small, advisory and bounded). Reuse canonical VAE and judgment-learning owners rather than inventing a parallel training engine. Main was 59 commits ahead of #226 on inspection; recover on fresh current-main branch.
